comments.author: LightoftheWorld
comments.body_html:
Clarification on something:

The reason the mod does what it does (only changes usec) is because this was initially a personal mod. I was actually working on simply changing the outfits of bear and usec to make them more distinct, when I got the idea from a friend to make the bots into the anime models. I play with FriendlyPMC, so unless I shoot them first, the USEC bots are my allies. This makes them very easy to pick out from the crowd, because they are the only glowing anime characters, and every other bot type (who is hostile) looks like normal Tarkov characters.

However, now that this is a mod, I plan on expanding the capabilities of it, AKA allowing any bod to become the anime with a config. When will I get that done? No clue. But definitely within the month of June
